# windows_volume (Data Source)

Reads the observed state of a formatted volume on a remote Windows host via SSH and PowerShell (`Get-Volume`) without managing it.

Lookup is by exactly one of `drive_letter` (a single letter, `C` allowed: reads never change the volume), `unique_id` (the stable `\\?\Volume{...}\` identity, preferred) or `file_system_label` (exact, case-insensitive; several matches are an error). Zero matches are an error, as is an unformatted (null/RAW file system) match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    windows = {
      source  = "kfrlabs/windows"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "windows" {
  host     = var.windows_host
  username = var.windows_username
  password = var.windows_password
}

# Look up a volume by its stable UniqueId without managing it.
data "windows_volume" "data" {
  unique_id = "\\\\?\\Volume{11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555}\\"
}

output "volume_label" {
  value = data.windows_volume.data.file_system_label
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `drive_letter` (String) Single drive letter A-Z (an optional trailing colon is allowed; `C` is allowed) of the volume to look up. Exactly one of drive_letter, unique_id and file_system_label must be specified.
- `file_system_label` (String) Exact Get-Volume FileSystemLabel of the volume to look up, matched case-insensitively. Exactly one of drive_letter, unique_id and file_system_label must be specified; several matches are an error.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `unique_id` (String) Stable Get-Volume UniqueId of the volume to look up. Exactly one of drive_letter, unique_id and file_system_label must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `allocation_unit_size` (Number) Allocation unit (cluster) size in bytes, as observed on the host.
- `drive_type` (String) Get-Volume DriveType (e.g. Fixed), as observed on the host.
- `file_system` (String) File system of the volume (NTFS, ReFS, exFAT, FAT32), as observed on the host.
- `health_status` (String) Get-Volume HealthStatus (e.g. Healthy), as observed on the host.
- `id` (String) Data source identifier; the stable Get-Volume UniqueId of the observed volume.
- `operational_status` (String) Get-Volume OperationalStatus (e.g. OK), as observed on the host.
- `partition_id` (String) Hosting partition in `<disk_unique_id>|<guid_or_offset>` form, as observed on the host (the `partition_id` a sibling `windows_volume` resource would manage).
- `path` (String) Get-Volume Path, as observed on the host.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Get-Volume Size in bytes, as observed on the host.
- `size_remaining_bytes` (Number) Get-Volume SizeRemaining in bytes, as observed on the host.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
